name: t26
why: t25 (t22's recipe on the corrected cache r9) with one change: every effect on a gene below 5 CPM in the context's own controls is set to 0, the cis head included. In each of A, B and C about 72% of t22's squared effect sits on the 46-48% of genes below 5 CPM (measured 29/09 on effects_t22 and interim/basal_cpm_by_context). t23 zeroed 8,247 genes that fewer than two universes estimate, most of them weakly expressed, and officially raised pds_cosine by +0.0109 raw (twelve times the seed's +0.0009) while nmae, reach and Jaccard fell (CP-0042); the genes t23 zeroed that the contexts do express are the likely cause of the DE losses (interpretation). The gate keeps every gene at or above 5 CPM untouched, so the detectable-gene count of match_detectable (genes >= 5 CPM) does not move and no rescale is needed. It uses only the context's controls, so it applies unchanged to D/E/F. Sources, weights, amplitude, shrinkage, gamma, cache and cis head as t25.
